data.name: Introduction
data.value: Our type system gives the brand an expressive voice while keeping the product clear, familiar, and easy to read.

data.name: BrandDescription
data.value: Coiny is our display voice. Use it sparingly for large, expressive brand moments—not for interface controls or long-form reading.

data.name: ProductDescription
data.value: Nunito is the product foundation for navigation, buttons, labels, forms, body copy, captions, and product headings.

data.name: RoleMatrixDescription
data.value: Choose typography by the job the text performs. Responsive sizing preserves hierarchy without sacrificing readability.

data.name: RoleBodyExample
data.value: Clear, comfortable reading for instructions and longer supporting content.

data.name: UseBrandCasing
data.value: Write the visible brand name as beeday, always lowercase.

data.name: UseHierarchy
data.value: Keep a clear hierarchy and let type wrap naturally on smaller screens.

data.name: UseReadability
data.value: Prioritize comfortable line length, contrast, and readable line spacing.

data.name: AvoidProductCoiny
data.value: Do not use Coiny for body copy, forms, navigation, labels, or buttons.

data.name: AvoidCasing
data.value: Do not style the visible brand as BeeDay or BEEDAY.

data.name: AvoidDistortion
data.value: Do not stretch, compress, outline, or add decorative effects to the typefaces.
